name: SolutionRaft Wholesale Pricing for WooCommerce
author: Solution Raft

sections.description:
SolutionRaft Wholesale Pricing for WooCommerce helps store owners offer wholesale pricing to approved customer accounts.

Features:

  • Adds a Wholesale Customer user role.
  • Applies a configurable global percentage discount to wholesale customers.
  • Allows a custom wholesale price on simple products.
  • Allows a custom wholesale price on individual product variations.
  • Provides a settings dashboard in the WordPress admin area.

This plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate SolutionRaft Wholesale Pricing for WooCommerce.
  4. Open Wholesale Pricing in the WordPress admin menu.
  5. Configure the global wholesale discount.
  6. Edit a user account and assign the Wholesale Customer role.
  7. Edit a product and set an optional wholesale price.
sections.faq:
How do I make a user a wholesale customer?

Edit the WordPress user and select Wholesale Customer as their role.

What happens when a product has no custom wholesale price?

The configured global discount is applied to the active WooCommerce product price.

Can I set different prices for variations?

Yes. Edit the variable product and enter a wholesale price for the relevant variation.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.
